bible_verses.telugu: దేవుడైన యెహోవా నేలమంటితో నరుని నిర్మించి వాని నాసికా రంధ్రములలో జీవవాయువును ఊదగా నరుడు జీవాత్మ ఆయెను.
bible_verses.english: Then the Lord God formed a man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.

bible_verses.telugu: గుండె చెదరినవారిని ఆయన బాగుచేయువాడు వారి గాయములు కట్టువాడు.
bible_verses.english: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

bible_verses.telugu: సకలప్రాణులు యెహోవాను స్తుతించుదురు గాక యెహోవాను స్తుతించుడి.
bible_verses.english: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Praise the Lord.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You for the incredible gift of life and for breathing Your very air into my lungs today. When my heart feels heavy or broken, remind me that You are my source of hope, light, and total restoration. Receive my praise now as a simple offer of love back to You. Use every breath I have to bring You glory. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, thank You for the incredible gift of life and for breathing Your very air into my lungs today. When my heart feels heavy or broken, remind me that You are my source of hope, light, and total restoration. Receive my praise now as a simple offer of love back to You. Use every breath I have to bring You glory. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Every single breath we take is an undeserved gift from a loving Creator. When we feel weary or broken, God gently reminds us that He is the one who breathes life, hope, and healing into our hearts. Our worship is simply giving back to Him what He has first given to us—our very breath. As you sing today, let your praise flow freely from a heart filled with gratitude for His restorative love.
